svg.aria-label: Svipall. An assistant on the left asks a website on the right for a page. Without Svipall the page stops at a wall and a Checking your browser waiting screen comes back instead. With Svipall the real pages pass through the gate to the assistant, and a page it could not open is marked as such.
svg.text: Your assistant reads the real page, not the “checking your browser” screen.
How much is the Pro plan?
Without it, the waiting screen comes back
With Svipall, the real page arrives
